sourceFile: 5. BRS-161014 Report check dimension AWF JIG 2023.11.2_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because it misdefines the change context and derives incorrect measurement outcomes for a new AWF jig dimension check.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the tested new AWF jig/dimension check.
Baseline/test conditions are not applicable or not stated; this is spec conformance.
Outcome stats wrongly treat jig item numbers as measurements.
Spec mapping is wrong for the 11.06~11.07 dimension.
Final OK result row is omitted from the case evidence.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new AWF jig dimension/spec verification.
Use spec conformance framing rather than baseline vs changed comparison.
Rebuild outcomes as two dimension metrics: 5.06~5.07 and 11.06~11.07.
Exclude jig sequence numbers from measurement statistics.
Cite header/spec rows, actual measurement rows, and final OK/need machine-check result row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient and partly misapplied; add measurement and final-result rows before use.
